rows.name: an EXPIRED invoice (60 s life) is refused on chain: InvoiceExpired (eth_call reason + a real mined revert); nothing moved; the service marks it expired
rows.detail: The contract function "pay" reverted.; service status undefined

rows.name: PAYING TWICE: the second payment of the same invoice (by another wallet) is refused: AlreadyPaid (reason + mined revert); the first stays the only payment
WRONG NATIVE VALUE: total-1, total+1 and 0 are all refused (WrongNativeValue); a real mined revert for total-1; the invoice is still payable afterwards

DISALLOWED TOKEN: after the owner removes the permit token from the allow-list the (validly signed) invoice is refused: TokenNotAllowed (mined revert); re-allowed, the same invoice pays; the service itself answers -11 for the never-allowed plain token

TAMPERED invoice: every changed field (amount, merchant, fee payer, invoice id, expiry; and a fee rate that is not the current one) with the original signature is refused (BadSignature / FeeChanged); a mined revert; a signature made by another key is refused (BadSignature)
rows.detail: amount - 1: refused; amount x10: refused; merchant swapped: refused; fee payer flipped: refused; invoiceId changed: refused; expiry extended: refused; fee rate 0: refused

rows.name: SurKMS CONTROL: a well-formed Invoice for the SurPay domain is signed; the signature recovers to the invoiceSigner key that SurPay.invoiceSigner() returns

SurKMS REFUSES: a non-Invoice typed message, a wrong domain name / contract / chain id / extra domain member, feeBps 201, expiry beyond 6 days or in the past, a token outside its list, amount 0, fee payer 2, a zero merchant, an extra or reordered field
